assumptions.unit: days from the demo clock date; minutes; UTC HH:MM daily start times
assumptions.basis: Plausible synthetic handover slots: two clear days to prepare the car, three days of choice and hour-long slots at two daily times. Not retailer calendar data; revisable here.
A half hour of demo time before the synthetic retailer answers a request makes the wait visible on a presenter tick. The call timeout bounds a stalled provider. Revisable demo assumptions.

value.proposalReason: The retailer proposed a different time.

assumptions.unit: difficult-case switch; alternative slot rule; reason text
assumptions.basis: Difficult-case switch for the synthetic provider. Off by default; when on, the provider answers with the next daily slot instead of the requested one and Paula must accept it.

choices.label: Return it when the new car is handed over
Return it on a separate day

assumptions.unit: choice IDs with labels; handover states; days from the demo clock date and from the handover; minutes; UTC HH:MM daily start times
assumptions.basis: Synthetic demo assumption: Paula may return the old car at the new car's handover or on a separate day within a week after it, once the handover is scheduled. A separate-day return can still be planned after the handover is completed (FUCQ-251). Not BMW policy; revisable here.

not-requested.nextStep: Choose when to return your current car.

requested.nextStep: Waiting for the retailer to confirm your return slot.

change-proposed.nextStep: Accept the new time to confirm your return.

scheduled.nextStep: Keep driving your current car until the return.

ineligible.nextStep: Confirm your new car's handover first, then plan the return.

pending.nextStep: Waiting for the scheme team to confirm the last update.

blocked.nextStep: The scheme team will review why this was not accepted.

assumptions.unit: owner and next-step label per return state
assumptions.basis: Synthetic demo assumption: who acts next at each return state (HLD review Q19, states reused from the handover appointment). Owners are Paula (employee), the retailer or the scheme team; labels are concise demo copy.

returned.nextStep: Your current car has been returned. Nothing more is needed from you.

missed.nextStep: The scheme team will contact you to rearrange the return of your current car.

assumptions.unit: scenario selection; seconds of demo time after the return slot ends; lifecycle-exception event type key
assumptions.basis: Physical return stays outside the main walkthrough, so it is off by default; a presenter scenario enables it and chooses returned or missed. Half an hour after the slot ends is a plausible time for the retailer to confirm. The exception type return-missed is its own key, selected by renewalCase.lifecycle.eventTypes, so the case is not read as a missed handover.
